blocks.html: Grandparents have a significant and growing impact on the well-being of their families. They have played a big role in shaping their children’s and grandchildren’s future. This September, show your love to your lolos and lolas by treating them to a day full of fun and excitement as Robinsons Malls brings hit-maker, John Ford Coley, to its stage in time for the celebration of Grandparents’ Day. John Ford Coley was famously known to be the other half of the American soft rock duo together with Dan Seals or “England Dan”. Throughout the 1970s, the duo topped the charts with eighteen Top 10 hits worldwide and nine singles with some becoming certified gold and platinum. Their most famous song was the 1976 hit single, “I’d Really Love to See You Tonight” which became a No. 1 song worldwide and was certified gold in several countries including the Philippines. This solidified their names in the music industry and made them more famous than before. As you celebrate Grandparents’ Day, let your lolos and lolas reminisce their youth as they listen to the songs of John Ford Coley live on September 10 at Robinsons Magnolia at 4:00 p.m.; September 9 at Robinsons Metro East, September 16 at Robinsons Place Tagum; and September 17 at Robinsons Galleria Cebu all at 5:00 p.m. For Coley’s 6:00 p.m. show, take your grandparents to Robinsons Place Manila on September 7, Robinsons Galleria on September 8, Robinsons Place Santiago on September 14 Robinsons Place Las Piñas on September 15 and Robinsons Place Tacloban on September 18. Aside from listening to the hits of John Ford Coley, you can also treat your Grandparents on their special day by bringing them to Robinsons Magnolia on September 9 as they watch the performance of the Philippines’ premier vocal ensemble and award-winning group, The Company. With hit songs such as “Everlasting Love”, “Muntik na Kitang Minahal” and “Now That I Have You”, your grandparents will surely have a wonderful time. But wait there’s more! You may also bring your dear lolos and lolas to Robinsons Novaliches as they become young-at-hearts once more as they listen to the songs of The Boyfriends on September 10 at 5 p.m. With their pop and disco harmonies reminiscent of the Bee Gees, your grandparents will definitely have the best grandparent’s day gift as they enjoy meaningful bonding moments with their families. Plus, selected Robinsons Malls also have additional surprises for your beloved grandparents’ special day as they enjoy good shopping, entertainment, dining and a whole lot of exciting activities at Robinsons Place Antipolo, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place Gen. Trias, Robinsons Place Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga and Robinsons Place Palawan.
